text: Call Issued: April 20, 2018 Call Closed: May 23, 2018 Number of Addenda Issued: None Number of Bids: One (1) Table 2: Summary of Bids Received for Request for Quotation No. 6027-18-0205 Including Bid Price Bidder Name Bid Price (including H.S.T.) Altec Industries Ltd. $685,840

The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (June 11, 2018) from the Chief Purchasing Officer: Call Number: Request for Quotation No. 6027-18-0205 Description: For the supply and delivery of two (2) latest model, international truck chassis and conventional three (3) person cab, with two (2) booms, hydraulically operated over centre aerial tower and a chipper dump body. Recommended Bidder: Altec Industries Ltd. Contract Award Value: $606,938 net of all applicable taxes and charges $685,840 including all applicable taxes and charges $617,620 net of HST recoveries Contract is expected to start on date of award and end on August 31, 2019.
